Dr Aaron Menahem: orthopaedic surgeon, joint replacement specialist

Professional overview:
Dr Aaron Menahem is a recognised orthopaedic and joint replacement surgeon, known for his outstanding work in the field of joint replacement. He heads the joint replacement department at the Assuta clinic.

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Osteoarthritis of the knee
  • Osteoarthritis of the hip
  • Coxarthrosis of the hip joint
  • Osteoarthritis of the knee joints
  • Osteoporosis
  • Osteomyelitis
  • Meniscus of the knee joint
  • Rheumatoid arthritis
  • Knee injuries
  • Hip injuries

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, University of Bologna, Italy.
  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel.
  • Course in orthopaedic surgery at the centre for therapy and rehabilitation in Davos, Switzerland.
  • Specialisation in orthopaedic surgery and joint replacement at the Bnai Zion medical centre, Haifa, Israel.

Clinical career:

  • More than 30 years of experience in orthopaedics and surgery, including heading a joint replacement department.

Academic and research achievements:

  • Author of more than 160 research papers in orthopaedics.
  • Teaching at medical institutions in Israel.

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Orthopaedic Association
  • Israel Society for Hip and Knee Surgery

Dr Alex Kalganov: orthopaedic surgeon, senior physician of the orthopaedics department

Professional overview:
Dr Alex Kalganov is a leading specialist and senior physician in the orthopaedics department of the Assuta medical centre. In more than 30 years of practice he has established himself as one of the best experts in Israel in joint replacement.

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Knee and hip replacement
  • Treatment of hallux valgus
  • Treatment of the meniscus of the knee joint
  • Arthroscopy of the knee joint

Education and professional experience:

  • Graduate of the medical university in Chelyabinsk, Russia
  • Residency in orthopaedic surgery at the city hospital in Chelyabinsk, Russia
  • Faculty of sports medicine, Tel Aviv University
  • Specialisation in joint replacement at the Ichilov medical centre, Tel Aviv, and at the Royal Hospital, London, England

Academic and research work:

  • Author of numerous research papers in orthopaedics
  • Developer of modern joint prostheses
  • International scientific expert for CRM (England), a developer of joint prostheses

Membership of professional organisations:

  • European Orthopaedic Association
  • Israel Orthopaedic Association
  • European Society of Joint Replacement

Additional positions:

  • Consultant to the sports medicine department of the orthopaedics unit at the Wingate Institute
  • Head of the health department of the Netanya municipality

Professor Anna Padua is a highly qualified gynaecologist and one of Israel's leading specialists in women's health, with more than twenty years of experience. She specialises in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of urinary disorders, pelvic organ prolapse and labiaplasty.

Key aspects of her work:

  • Exceptional expertise in gynaecology.
  • Use of modern treatment methods with a minimal risk of complications.
  • A leading position in the international community, helped by her command of English and Russian.

Education and experience:

  • Medical degree from Tel Aviv University.
  • Specialisation in surgical gynaecology, followed by work at the Assaf Harofeh hospital.
  • Fellowship in female urology at the San Carlo clinical centre in Rome.

Academic and teaching work:

  • Publications in medical journals and active participation in international conferences.
  • Teaching at Tel Aviv University and supervision of students' clinical practice.

Membership of professional organisations:

  • Israel Association of Obstetrics and Gynaecology.
  • European College of Aesthetic Medicine and Surgery (ECAMS).
  • Israel Urogynaecology Society.
  • International Urogynecological Association (IUGA).
  • International Continence Society (ICS).

Main areas of specialisation

  • Diagnosis and treatment of gynaecological conditions
  • Treatment of infertility (conservative)
  • IVF
  • Cryopreservation (freezing) of eggs
  • Restoring reproductive function after malignant disease; monitoring the course of pregnancy and carrying out diagnostic investigations during pregnancy
  • Preserving reproductive function in women with cancer
  • Amniocentesis, diagnostic puncture of the amniotic fluid

Professor Avi Ben-Harush is a leading specialist in obstetrics, gynaecology and reproductive medicine, and a recognised expert of international standing. For over 25 years he has advised and treated women facing infertility, and has performed operations in assisted reproduction and in restoring reproductive function after cancer.

Patients from around the world come to Professor Ben-Harush for high-quality medical care. During surgical procedures he pays particular attention to preserving the ability to bear children.

IVF, the most widely used procedure, is supported by the many-sided methods of in vitro fertilisation that the professor employs. His individual approach to each patient's treatment ensures the best possible outcome, even for those who have not previously succeeded with IVF.

Alongside his clinical practice, the professor takes an active part in research and publishes on infertility. His educational work includes lectures, contributions to teaching materials and the running of practical seminars.

The professor is also an excellent teacher, passing his experience on to a new generation of doctors.

Patients single out the kindness and high professionalism of Avi Ben-Harush, who has made a great many long-awaited pregnancies possible.

Education

  • Doctor of Medicine (MD), Faculty of Medicine, Ben-Gurion University, Beersheba, Israel
  • Second degree in obstetrics and gynaecology, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in assisted reproduction and the restoration of reproductive function, Beilinson hospital, Petah Tikva, Israel
  • Fellowship in IVF, McGill University, Montreal, Canada

Membership of international associations

  • Member of the Israel Association of Obstetrics and Gynaecology
  • Member of the Israel Fertility Preservation Society

Dr Avi Hefetz is recognised as one of the most highly qualified otolaryngologists internationally. His expertise is valued highly outside Israel as well. His extensive experience in head and neck oncology spans more than 30 years of practice.

In 2009, together with Roi Landsberg and Michal Luntz, he co-founded a leading clinic in the region specialising in the treatment of head and neck disease at the Assuta medical centre. Dr Hefetz has performed a great many successful operations to remove cancerous growths in patients of all ages, making active use of the Mohs technique.

His gift as a lecturer is borne out by his many appearances. He is also a professor in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University and the author of more than 70 research papers in prestigious medical journals. His professional achievements include more than 100 scientific presentations in Israel and abroad.

His expertise was recognised recently when he became a consultant to the Israel Cancer Association on head and neck surgery and oncology.

EDUCATION

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Residency in the otolaryngology department of the Kaplan hospital, Israel
  • Fellowship in head and neck surgery at the Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York, USA
  • Fellowship in head and neck cancer surgery at the University of Oklahoma medical centre, USA

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Association of Otolaryngologists
  • American Head and Neck Society
  • Chairman of the international society for head and neck cancer surgery

Boris Aranovich
Specialisation: neurologist, epileptologist

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Neurodegenerative diseases
  • Diseases of the cerebral blood vessels
  • Leukoaraiosis of the brain
  • Addressing dizziness and loss of balance
  • Prevention of stroke
  • Memory disorders
  • Multiple sclerosis
  • Treatment of headache and migraine
  • Treatment of depression and borderline mental states
  • Second opinions in neurology

Summary:

Dr Boris Aranovich is a recognised and authoritative specialist in neurology and diseases of the cerebral blood vessels. He has some 40 years of experience, 30 of them working as a neurologist in Israel's largest clinics. He specialises in treating disorders and various diseases of the brain, and neurodegenerative conditions such as Alzheimer's disease, corticobasal degeneration and primary lateral sclerosis.

Dr Aranovich is a leading specialist in the treatment and prevention of stroke and epilepsy. He has exceptional diagnostic skills and uses the most innovative approaches to the diagnosis and treatment of neurological disease, which allows him to reach accurate diagnoses and to determine the nature of the disorder and how far it has progressed.

Dr Aranovich may fairly be called an expert of international standing on diseases of the cerebral blood vessels. He is often called upon at national level as an expert in assessing complex cases of neurological disease, determining degrees of disability and providing medical opinions for insurance companies.

Dr Aranovich shares his extensive experience actively, contributes to the development of effective approaches to treating neurological disease and takes part regularly in international symposia and conferences.

Education:

  • Institute of Expert Assessment, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Degrees: MD, PhD, Doctor of Medicine

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Dr Boris Aranovich is known for his invaluable contribution to neurology and to the study of cerebral vascular disease, thanks to which many patients have received medical care of the highest quality and returned to full lives.
